prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too high overall, though several strong winners (such as sign_in redesign in round 6, choose_path redesign in round 10, adoption new_flow in round 12, adoption incentive in round 13, choose_path copy in round 14, and finish redesign in round 15) were underpredicted.
Sign_in hint changes were helpful, winning 3 of 8 tests (rounds 1, 7, and 15), while the remaining 5 tests showed no clear effect.
Home wait_info changes were helpful, winning 2 of 8 tests (rounds 13 and 14), while the other 6 tests showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign changes (5 tests) consistently showed no clear effect or hurt performance, with zero wins.
Finish new_screen changes (3 tests) consistently showed no clear effect or hurt performance, with zero wins.
Evidence remains thin or outcomes are mixed for single-test categories and categories with conflicting results (such as choose_path redesign, finish redesign, home notification, adoption incentive, and sign_in redesign).

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Companion Selection Redesign: Redesigns the friend selection screen into a clean grid layout showcasing available desktop companion styles clearly. (why: Adoption has the steepest funnel drop (66.9% conversion, 89s median duration). A structured grid presentation simplifies character comparison.)
1: [finish, redesign] Home Desktop Control Overview Checklist: Rebuilds the home intro welcome screen into an interactive checklist outlining how to interact with, move, and hide your pet. (why: Finish drops to 72.5% and users contacted support stating they were confused about controlling or hiding their pet after setup.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Pet Restoration Reassurance Hint: Displays a hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in preserves your pet's memory and settings. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Companion Status Wait Info: Shows a progress indicator and explicit status message while desktop pet assets initialize. (why: Home wait step has a high median time (201s) and support emails noted app stalling or pet missing on initial startup.)
4: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Mascot Preview Redesign: Redesigns the path selection screen into a spotlight layout focusing on the main companion paths. (why: A visually prominent path selection design reduces decision friction at the initial onboarding gate.)
5: [finish, notification] Finish Desktop Controls Tip Notification: Adds a helpful notification hint on how to trigger desktop pet controls when onboarding finishes. (why: Multiple support emails asked how to control, hide, or talk to their pet post-onboarding.)
6: [adoption, hint] Adoption Custom Pet Guidance Hint: Adds a hint on photo upload providing simple quality tips for custom pet creation. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual results.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Choose Path Quick Start Headline Copy: Updates the choose path headline and action button copy to make starting immediate and clear. (why: Reduces mean time spent on choose path screen by clarifying next steps.)
8: [finish, new_screen] Home Desktop Spawn Setup New Screen: Adds a final desktop spawn confirmation screen after home intro showing pet placement guidance. (why: Addresses support complaints where pets fail to appear on screen or users are unaware the pet has spawned.)

scores.note: Adoption redesigns consistently underperform or hurt conversion across 5 tests.

Home wait info changes won 2 of 8 tests with +1.6% average lift addressing long wait times.
Choose path redesign has slight positive historic lift (+0.9%) but high implementation cost.
Notifications generally show no clear effect or slight negative lift (-0.3%).
